Initial release of the mortgage TRID timeline compliance checklist.

- Provides domain-specific triggers for when to activate timeline review (application hits 6 items, closing approaching, re-disclosure events).
- Outlines key TRID disclosure timing rules: LE within 3 business days, CD at least 3 business days before closing, and re-disclosure triggers.
- Includes practical verification checklist and compliance references.
- Presents worked example and "red flag" scenarios for risk awareness.
- Offers use-case packs for solo loan officers and brokerages with alerting.
- Emphasizes gate discipline and documentation for regulatory compliance.
